cause: The campaign exhausted the Vercel AI Gateway balance. The parent, every non-review helper and the judge were pinned to vercel-ai-gateway/openai/gpt-6.1-sol:low by the issue, and every subject reviewer also billed through the same gateway. The operator did not want this spend.
failure: omp provider error: 402 A positive credit balance is required for all requests, including BYOK, so fallback providers remain available. (type=insufficient_funds)
action: Stopped all dispatch and stood down at the operator's instruction. No retry, no fallback to another provider, no purchase, no plan change, no credential change.
consequence: The 16 refused slots are not model results and must be rerun if the campaign resumes. The 24 completed attempts are preserved as evidence only; they are not a complete cohort and are not compared with another arm. The other six arms have no cohort attempts.
